svg.title: A workbook has a Summary sheet and an Orders sheet. Ciaren imports one sheet: the first unless you name another under Import options. The Parquet file stores one type per column. The zip that Excel displays as 02134 is the number 2134, so Parquet stores 2134.
svg.text: one sheet becomes the dataset: the first, unless you name it
Q1 totals are on the Orders sheet
imported when no sheet is named
Excel only displayed 02134: the value is 2134
